class.description: ! Creation and modification of an isolated (positional) light source. ! It is also defined by the color and two attenuation factors ConstAttentuation() and ! LinearAttentuation(). The resulting attenuation factor determining the illumination of a surface ! depends on the following formula: ! @code ! F = 1 / (ConstAttenuation() + LinearAttenuation() * Distance) ! @endcode ! Where Distance is the distance of the isolated source from the surface.
